verses.en: Come near, ye nations, to hear; and hearken, ye people: let the earth hear, and all that is therein; the world, and all things that come forth of it.
verses.sm: Ina faalatalata mai ia outou nuu ese ina ia faalogologo mai ai; outou nuu foi, uai mai ia o outou taliga; faalogologo mai ia le lalolagi ma mea uma ua tumu ai, o le atu laulau ma mea uma ua tutupu mai ai.

verses.en: For the indignation of the LORD is upon all nations, and his fury upon all their armies: he hath utterly destroyed them, he hath delivered them to the slaughter.
verses.sm: Ana o loo i nuu ese uma le toatamai o le ALII, o lona toasa foi o loo i a latou “au uma lava; ua ia faafanoina i latou, ua ia tuuina atu lava i latou ia fasiotia.

verses.en: Their slain also shall be cast out, and their stink shall come up out of their carcases, and the mountains shall be melted with their blood.
verses.sm: E lafoaiina lo latou fasi, e alu ae foi le elo i o latou tino oti, e tafeesea mauga i o latou toto.

verses.en: And all the host of heaven shall be dissolved, and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll: and all their host shall fall down, as the leaf falleth off from the vine, and as a falling fig from the fig tree.
verses.sm: E mavae foi ‘au uma lava a O le faasalaina 0 Etoma le lagi, e taataaia le lagi e pei o se tusi; e pauu a latou ‘au uma lava, e pei ona pauu o lau o le vine, e pei ona pauu o lau o le mati.

verses.en: For my sword shall be bathed in heaven: behold, it shall come down upon Idumea, and upon the people of my curse, to judgment.
verses.sm: Aua e ona lau pelu i le lagi; faauta, e alu ifo ia i luga o Etoma, i luga lava o le nuu ua ou faafanoina, ina ia faasalaina.

verses.en: The sword of the LORD is filled with blood, it is made fat with fatness, and with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams: for the LORD hath a sacrifice in Bozrah, and a great slaughter in the land of Idumea.
verses.sm: Ua ma'ona le pelu a le ALII i le toto; ua malie i le ga‘0; o le toto o tamai mamoe ma “on, o le ga‘o o i ai fatuga‘o o mamoe poa; aua e i le ALII le taulaga i Posara, ma le fasi tele i le laueleele o Etoma.

verses.en: And the unicorns shall come down with them, and the bullocks with the bulls; and their land shall be soaked with blood, and their dust made fat with fatness.
verses.sm: E pauu foi rema faatasi ma i latou, ma povi taanoa faatasi ma povi poa; e onà o latou laueleele i le toto, e málie foi lo latou efuefu i le ga'o.

verses.en: For it is the day of the LORD'S vengeance, and the year of recompences for the controversy of Zion.
verses.sm: Aua e i le ALII le aso e taui ai ma sui; o le tausaga e taui atu ai i e O finau ma Siona.

verses.en: And the streams thereof shall be turned into pitch, and the dust thereof into brimstone, and the land thereof shall become burning pitch.
verses.sm: E liu pulu safeta ona vaitafe, e liu teio foi ona efuefu, e avea foi lona laueleele ma pulu safeta o mu.

verses.en: It shall not be quenched night nor day; the smoke thereof shall go up for ever: from generation to generation it shall lie waste; none shall pass through it for ever and ever.
verses.sm: E le tineia lava ia i le po, po o le ao; e pusa ae pea lava lona asu; e tuufua ia i lea tupulaga ma lea tupulaga, e le uia e faavavau faavavau lava.

verses.en: But the cormorant and the bittern shall possess it; the owl also and the raven shall dwell in it: and he shall stretch out upon it the line of confusion, and the stones of emptiness.
verses.sm: A e faia mo kati ma kifota; e nonofo ai foi o inesofe ma oreva; na te faloina foi i ona luga le fua e faagaogaoina ai, ma le fua faatautau e faatuufuaina ai.

verses.en: They shall call the nobles thereof to the kingdom, but none shall be there, and all her princes shall be nothing.
verses.sm: E le o i ai foi ni ona alii latou te tofia e pule; o ona alii sili e le toe ai lava so latou.

verses.en: And thorns shall come up in her palaces, nettles and brambles in the fortresses thereof: and it shall be an habitation of dragons, and a court for owls.
verses.sm: E tutupu ae laau tuitui i ona maota, o vao ogoogo foi ma laau talatala e tutupu i ona ‘olo; e avea foi ma mea e nonofo ai luko, ma mea e nonofo ai iaena.

verses.en: The wild beasts of the desert shall also meet with the wild beasts of the island, and the satyr shall cry to his fellow; the screech owl also shall rest there, and find for herself a place of rest.
verses.sm: E fetaiai ai manu feai o le vao ma aje; e fevalaauai foi “oti o le vao, e nofo filemu ai le lilita, e maua ai foi e ia se mea e malolo ai.

verses.en: There shall the great owl make her nest, and lay, and hatch, and gather under her shadow: there shall the vultures also be gathered, every one with her mate.
verses.sm: E fai ai e le kifosa lona ofaga, ma tuu ai ona fua, ma togitogi ai, e ufiufi foi i a i lona tino; e faapotopoto ai taie e tailua.

verses.en: Seek ye out of the book of the LORD, and read: no one of these shall fail, none shall want her mate: for my mouth it hath commanded, and his spirit it hath gathered them.
verses.sm: Ina sailiili ia i le tusi a le ALII, ma faitau i ai; e leai so latou e iu vale; e leai se tasi e le iloa lona soa; aua o lona fofoga ua fetalai atu ai, o lona agaga foi, o ia na te faapotopotoina i latou.

verses.en: And he hath cast the lot for them, and his hand hath divided it unto them by line: they shall possess it for ever, from generation to generation shall they dwell therein.
verses.sm: O ia foi na faia le vili mo i latou, o lona aao na vaevaeina ai mo i latou i le fua faataoto; e faia mo i latou e faavavau, latou te mau ai i lea tupulaga ma lea tupulaga.
